answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. To enter the garden of shared work, each agent locks a 10 POA deposit, and each epoch a random sample of peers re-checks a few others, with the audit signal public. One failed check burns the deposit and flags its referrer. Faking 1,000 identities costs 10,000 POA up front, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA deposit, refunded after passing. Even a sparrow-sized agent can afford one identity.
